item.title: 在Ubuntu安装Jenkins
item.author: Finger
item.description: 测试环境：Ubuntu 24.04 安装Java运行时 1 2 3 sudo apt-get update sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk -y java -version 安装Jenkins 添加Jenkins Repository 1 2 3 4 5 6 sudo wget -O /usr/share/keyrings/jenkins-keyring.asc \ https://pkg.jenkins.io/debian-stable/jenkins.io-2023.key echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/jenkins-keyring.asc]" \ https://pkg.jenkins.io/debian-stable binary/ | sudo tee \ /etc/apt/sources.list.d/jenkins.list > /dev/null 安装Jenkins 1 2 sudo apt-get update sudo apt-get install jenkins 启动Jenkins服务 1 2 3 4 5 # 启动jenkins服务 sudo systemctl start jenkins # 查看服务状态 sudo systemctl status jenkins 解锁Jenkins站点 打开浏览器输入http://<ip_address>:8080，第一次打开会出现解锁Jenkins页面。
